hd:speech:mis_xa2_evabriefing01: Sir, if you can secure the area around LAX and then get an engineer inside, we will have access to paratrooper reinforcements.

hd:speech:mis_xs5_yurinomorefriends: NO!!! (pause to regain control) Well, now you’ve done it, General. (dry sarcasm) I fear we can no longer be friends.
hd:speech:mis_xs5_zofiastrangereadings: Look out, sir, we are getting strange power readings from those statues.
hd:speech:mis_xs5_zofiaeasterislewarning: Sweet Stalin, Yuri has turned those monuments into weapons.
hd:speech:mis_xs5_zofiamaybeanengineer: Perhaps an engineer could acquire this statue to work for us.
hd:speech:eva_secretlabcaptured: Secret lab captured. New technology available.
hd:speech:mis_xs6_zofiagototheeast: Commander General, to the east there is open ground suitable for base construction, but beyond, our operatives report that Yuri has more than one base in the area.
hd:speech:mis_xs6_yuricashtaunt: I sense your cash reserves are almost depleted.
hd:speech:mis_xs6_yuriscreamtaunt: So you discovered my little hideway?  No one will hear you scream, so far from Earth.
hd:speech:s06_p02: Our infantry must wear cosmonaut suits. These are equipped with lasers and rocket packs. Yuri's base is north of our position. Good luck, Kamrat General.
hd:speech:mis_xs6_zofianoresources: There are no resources on this airless rock, Comrade General. You must make the best of the funds you already have. Good luck!
hd:speech:mis_xs4_yuriinevitable: You’ve only succeeded in delaying the inevitable, I will win.
hd:speech:mis_xs6_zofiawelldone: Well done, Comrade General. Victory will soon be ours.
hd:speech:unit_sofia_floatdisc: Beware of these Floating Discs, Comrade General. Yuri has designed them to drain power from our Tesla and nuclear reactors, as well as our other defensive buildings. If they get near a refinery, they are even better thieves than the accursed Allied spies.
hd:speech:unit_sofia_mastermind: This thing is Yuri's mastermind. It can take control of our units just as Yuri himself can. We have discovered its weakness though. It can only control so many of our units before it overloads itself and is destroyed.
hd:speech:mis_xs6_zofiamagnetronintro: Sir, Yuri is deploying a new unit called the magnetron. It can generate a powerful electromagnetic field that can drag our tanks towards it.
hd:speech:mis_xs7_zofiafreedomfighters: Commander, this group of freedom fighters is willing to join us in this final battle against Yuri. They should prove most useful.
hd:speech:s07_p01: Its location is directly north of your present position. Unfortunately allied troops to the west and Soviet troops to the east are both under the control of Yuri's psychic beacons. Destroy the beacons and they will join you in battle.
hd:speech:mis_xs7_yurigrowweary: I’ve grown weary of waiting for you to make up your mind.  Wherever you make your base, you will be unable to defend it from my forces…or those of my Soviet…and my Allied pawns.
hd:speech:mis_xs7_zofiaalliancewarning: Commander, be advised that Yuri is combining his own forces with Soviet and Allied units that he controls to strengthen their attacks against you.
hd:speech:mis_xs7_yurisuperweapons: A good thought commander, I think my puppets should follow your example and build their own superweapons.
hd:speech:mis_xs7_zofiabackdoornotice: Look, Comrade General, a back door. Perhaps if you send some engineers through to capture the psychic beacon, you might wrest control of the Soviet base from Yuri.
hd:speech:unit_sofia_miragetank: Another annoying trick of the Allies. The Mirage tank can mask itself as almost any object nearby it and then remain concealed and fire upon us.
